ad|md: Andorra and Moldova are both vertical blue-yellow-red with an emblem in the center. Moldova's emblem is a brown eagle holding a shield; Andorra's is a quartered shield with a mitre and two cows, and no eagle.
ad|ro: Andorra and Romania are both vertical blue, yellow and red. Romania's flag is plain, while Andorra has a coat of arms on a slightly wider yellow center band.
ad|td: Andorra and Chad are both vertical blue, yellow and red. Chad's flag is plain with a dark blue stripe, while Andorra has a coat of arms on a slightly wider yellow center band.
ae|jo: The UAE and Jordan both use red, green, white and black. The UAE has a red vertical band with green on top; Jordan has a red triangle with a white star and black on top.
ae|kw: The UAE and Kuwait both have green, white and a fourth color beside a hoist shape. The UAE has a red rectangle and black bottom stripe; Kuwait has a black trapezoid and red bottom stripe.
ae|ps: The UAE and Palestine both use red, green, white and black. Palestine has a red triangle with black on top; the UAE has a straight red vertical band with green on top.
ae|sd: The UAE and Sudan both use red, green, white and black. Sudan has a green triangle with red on top; the UAE has a straight red vertical band with green on top.
al|me: Albania and Montenegro both show a double-headed eagle on red. Albania's eagle is black with no border; Montenegro's is gold and the flag has a gold border.
ar|gt: Argentina and Guatemala are both light blue, white and light blue with a central emblem. Argentina's stripes are horizontal with a gold sun; Guatemala's are vertical with a coat of arms.
ar|hn: Argentina and Honduras are both blue-white-blue horizontal stripes. Argentina has a gold sun in the center; Honduras has five blue stars in an X shape.
ar|ni: Argentina and Nicaragua are both blue-white-blue horizontal stripes with a central emblem. Argentina's is a gold sun with a face; Nicaragua's is a triangle in a ring of text.
ar|sv: Argentina and El Salvador are both blue-white-blue horizontal stripes with a central emblem. Argentina's is a gold sun; El Salvador's is a triangle with flags and a wreath, and its blue is darker.
ar|uy: Argentina and Uruguay both use light blue, white and a gold Sun of May. Argentina has three stripes with the sun centered; Uruguay has nine stripes with the sun in the upper-left corner.
at|lb: Austria and Lebanon are both red-white-red horizontal stripes. Lebanon has a green cedar tree on a taller white band; Austria's flag is plain with equal stripes.
at|lv: Austria and Latvia are both red-white-red horizontal stripes. Latvia's red is dark maroon and its white stripe is narrow; Austria's red is bright and the three stripes are equal.
at|pe: Austria and Peru are both red-white-red. Austria's stripes are horizontal; Peru's are vertical.
au|fj: Australia and Fiji both have the Union Jack in the corner. Australia is dark blue with white stars; Fiji is light blue with a shield in the fly.
au|gb: Australia's flag has the United Kingdom's Union Jack in its upper-left corner. The UK flag is the Union Jack alone, while Australia adds a dark blue field with white stars.
au|nz: Australia and New Zealand are both dark blue with the Union Jack and the Southern Cross. New Zealand has four red stars with white edges; Australia has six white stars, including a large one under the Union Jack.
au|tv: Australia and Tuvalu both have the Union Jack in the corner. Australia is dark blue with white stars; Tuvalu is light blue with nine yellow stars.
az|tr: Azerbaijan and Turkey both show a white crescent and star on red. Turkey's flag is all red; Azerbaijan's red is only the middle of blue, red and green stripes.
az|uz: Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan both have blue top and green bottom stripes with a white crescent. Azerbaijan's middle stripe is red with the crescent centered; Uzbekistan's is white, with the crescent and stars in the upper-left corner.
ba|xk: Bosnia and Herzegovina and Kosovo are both blue with gold and white stars. Bosnia has a yellow triangle with a diagonal line of stars; Kosovo has a gold map under an arc of six stars.
bb|vc: Barbados and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines both have vertical blue and gold bands. Barbados is blue-gold-blue with a black trident; Saint Vincent is blue-gold-green with three green diamonds.
bd|jp: Bangladesh and Japan both show a red disc. Japan's field is white with the disc exactly centered; Bangladesh's field is dark green with the disc slightly towards the hoist.
bd|pw: Bangladesh and Palau both have a large disc placed slightly towards the hoist. Bangladesh is a red disc on dark green; Palau is a yellow disc on light blue.
be|de: Belgium and Germany both use black, yellow/gold and red. Belgium's stripes are vertical (black, yellow, red); Germany's are horizontal (black, red, gold).
bg|hu: Bulgaria and Hungary are both horizontal white, green and red. Bulgaria has white on top; Hungary has red on top and white in the middle.
bg|ir: Bulgaria and Iran are both horizontal white, green and red. Bulgaria has white on top and no emblem; Iran has green on top with a red emblem and white script.
bg|tj: Bulgaria and Tajikistan are both horizontal white, green and red. Bulgaria has white on top and no emblem; Tajikistan has red on top and a gold crown and stars on a wide white middle.
bh|qa: Bahrain and Qatar both have a white hoist band with a zigzag edge. Bahrain is bright red with five points; Qatar is maroon with nine points and a much longer flag.
bj|gw: Benin and Guinea-Bissau both have a vertical hoist band and two horizontal bands. Benin's band is plain green with yellow over red; Guinea-Bissau's is red with a black star, with yellow over green.
bj|mg: Benin and Madagascar both have a vertical hoist band and two horizontal bands. Benin is green at the hoist with yellow over red; Madagascar is white at the hoist with red over green.
bo|et: Bolivia and Ethiopia both have horizontal red, yellow and green stripes with a central emblem. Bolivia has red on top; Ethiopia has green on top and a blue disc with a yellow star.
bo|gh: Bolivia and Ghana are both red, yellow and green from top to bottom. Ghana has a black star in the center; Bolivia has a coat of arms or no emblem.
bo|lt: Bolivia and Lithuania both use horizontal red, yellow and green stripes. Bolivia goes red, yellow, green from the top; Lithuania goes yellow, green, red.
bo|mm: Bolivia and Myanmar both use horizontal red, yellow and green stripes. Bolivia has red on top; Myanmar has yellow on top and a large white star across all three stripes.
bs|jm: The Bahamas and Jamaica both use black, gold and a third color. The Bahamas has horizontal aquamarine and gold stripes with a black triangle; Jamaica has a gold diagonal cross with green and black triangles.
bw|ee: Botswana and Estonia both use blue, black and white stripes. Botswana is light blue with a thin black band in the middle; Estonia has three equal stripes, blue, black and white.
ca|lb: Canada and Lebanon are both red and white with a plant emblem in the center. Canada's red bands are vertical at the sides with a red maple leaf; Lebanon's are horizontal with a green cedar.
ca|pe: Canada and Peru both have vertical red-white-red bands. Peru's three bands are equal with no maple leaf; Canada's white center is twice as wide and holds a red maple leaf.
cd|cg: DR Congo and the Republic of the Congo both have a rising diagonal band. DR Congo is sky blue with a red band and a yellow star; the Republic of the Congo is green, yellow and red with no star.
cd|na: DR Congo and Namibia both have a red diagonal band from bottom-left to top-right. DR Congo is all sky blue with a yellow star; Namibia has blue and green triangles and a gold sun.
cd|tz: DR Congo and Tanzania both have a yellow-edged diagonal band from bottom-left to top-right. DR Congo's band is red on sky blue with a star; Tanzania's is black, between green and blue triangles.
cg|tz: The Republic of the Congo and Tanzania both have a green upper triangle and a diagonal band. Congo's band is plain yellow with red below; Tanzania's band is black edged in yellow, with blue below.
ch|dk: Switzerland and Denmark both have a white cross on red. Switzerland's flag is square with a short centered cross; Denmark's cross reaches the edges and sits towards the hoist.
ch|to: Switzerland and Tonga both show a cross on red and white. Switzerland has a white cross in the center of a square flag; Tonga has a red cross in a white box in the upper-left corner.
ci|ie: Ivory Coast and Ireland are both vertical orange, white and green. Ivory Coast has orange at the hoist (left); Ireland has green at the hoist.
ci|in: Ivory Coast and India both use orange, white and green. Ivory Coast's stripes are vertical and plain; India's are horizontal with a blue wheel in the center.
ci|ne: Ivory Coast and Niger both use orange, white and green. Ivory Coast's stripes are vertical and plain; Niger's are horizontal with an orange disc in the center.
cl|cu: Chile and Cuba both use red, white and blue with one white star. Chile's star is in a blue square in the corner; Cuba's is in a red triangle at the hoist, with blue and white stripes.
cl|lr: Chile and Liberia both have one white star in a blue square in the corner. Chile has just two bands, white over red; Liberia has eleven red and white stripes.
cl|us: Chile and the United States both have a blue corner square with white stars over red and white. Chile has one star and two bands; the US has 50 stars and thirteen stripes.
cm|gn: Cameroon and Guinea are both vertical green, red and yellow. Cameroon goes green, red, yellow with a yellow star; Guinea goes red, yellow, green with no star.
cm|ml: Cameroon and Mali both have vertical stripes starting with green. Cameroon's middle stripe is red with a yellow star; Mali's middle stripe is yellow with no star.
cm|sn: Cameroon and Senegal both have vertical stripes starting with green and a star in the middle. Cameroon's middle stripe is red with a yellow star; Senegal's is yellow with a green star.
cn|vn: China and Vietnam are both red with yellow stars. Vietnam has one large star in the center; China has one large star and four small ones in the upper-left corner.
co|ec: Colombia and Ecuador are both yellow, blue and red with a double-height yellow band. Ecuador has a coat of arms with a condor in the center; Colombia's flag is plain.
co|ve: Colombia and Venezuela are both yellow, blue and red stripes. Colombia's yellow takes up half the flag and it has no stars; Venezuela's stripes are equal with an arc of white stars.
cr|kp: Costa Rica and North Korea both run blue, white, red, white, blue. North Korea has very thin white stripes and a red star in a white disc; Costa Rica has wider white stripes and an oval coat of arms.
cr|th: Costa Rica and Thailand both have five stripes with a double-height center band. Costa Rica has blue outside and red in the middle; Thailand swaps them, with red outside and blue in the middle.
cu|cz: Cuba and Czechia both have a triangle at the hoist. Cuba has a red triangle with a white star on blue-and-white stripes; Czechia has a plain blue triangle on two bands, white over red.
cu|gr: Cuba and Greece both have blue and white horizontal stripes. Cuba has five stripes and a red triangle with a white star at the hoist; Greece has nine stripes and a blue square with a white cross in the corner.
cu|ph: Cuba and the Philippines both have a triangle at the hoist. Cuba's is red with a white star on blue-and-white stripes; the Philippines' is white with a gold sun and stars, on two bands, blue over red.
cy|xk: Cyprus and Kosovo both show a map of the country in the center. Cyprus has a copper map with olive branches on white; Kosovo has a gold map under six white stars on blue.
cz|ph: Czechia and the Philippines both have a triangle at the hoist and a red lower band. Czechia has a blue triangle with white on top; the Philippines has a white triangle with a gold sun, with blue on top.
cz|pl: Czechia and Poland are both white over red. Czechia adds a blue triangle at the hoist; Poland has just the two plain bands.
dk|no: Denmark and Norway both have an off-center cross on red. Denmark's cross is plain white; Norway's is blue with a white border.
do|pa: The Dominican Republic and Panama both have blue and red quarters. The Dominican Republic has a white cross with a coat of arms between them; Panama has two white quarters, each with a star, and no cross.
dz|mr: Algeria and Mauritania both use green with a crescent and star. Algeria is half green, half white with a red crescent; Mauritania is all green with a yellow crescent and red stripes at top and bottom.
dz|pk: Algeria and Pakistan both pair green and white with a crescent and star. Algeria splits into equal halves with a red crescent; Pakistan has a narrow white strip at the hoist and a white crescent on dark green.
ec|ve: Ecuador and Venezuela are both yellow, blue and red. Ecuador's yellow band fills the top half and it has a coat of arms with a condor; Venezuela's bands are equal, with an arc of white stars on the blue.
eg|iq: Egypt and Iraq are both red, white and black. Egypt has a gold eagle in the center; Iraq has green Arabic script instead.
eg|sd: Egypt and Sudan are both red, white and black. Egypt has a gold eagle in the center; Sudan has a green triangle at the hoist.
eg|sy: Egypt and Syria both have white and black stripes with an emblem in the middle. Egypt's top stripe is red with a gold eagle; Syria's top stripe is green, with three red stars.
eg|ye: Egypt and Yemen are both red, white and black. Egypt has a gold eagle in the center; Yemen's flag is plain.
et|gh: Ethiopia and Ghana both use green, yellow and red stripes with a star. Ethiopia has green on top and a blue disc; Ghana has red on top and a plain black star.
et|lt: Ethiopia and Lithuania both use green, yellow and red stripes. Ethiopia has green on top and a blue disc with a star; Lithuania has yellow on top and no emblem.
fi|gr: Finland and Greece both use blue and white with a cross. Finland is a single blue cross on white; Greece has blue-and-white stripes with a small white cross in the corner.
fj|gb: Fiji uses the United Kingdom's Union Jack in its corner. The UK flag is the Union Jack alone; Fiji's has a light blue field with a shield on the right.
fj|nz: Fiji and New Zealand both have the Union Jack in the corner. Fiji's field is light blue with a shield; New Zealand's is dark blue with four red stars.
fj|tv: Fiji and Tuvalu both have the Union Jack on a light blue field. Fiji has a shield on the right; Tuvalu has nine scattered yellow stars.
fm|so: Micronesia and Somalia both have white stars on light blue. Somalia has one large star; Micronesia has four small stars in a diamond.
fr|it: France and Italy both have vertical stripes with white in the middle and red at the fly. France starts with blue; Italy starts with green.
fr|nl: France and the Netherlands both use red, white and blue. France's stripes are vertical, blue first; the Netherlands' are horizontal, red on top.
ga|sl: Gabon and Sierra Leone both have green on top and blue at the bottom. The middle stripe tells them apart: yellow for Gabon, white for Sierra Leone.
gb|nz: New Zealand uses the United Kingdom's Union Jack in its corner. The UK flag is the Union Jack alone; New Zealand's has a dark blue field with four red stars on the right.
gb|tv: Tuvalu uses the United Kingdom's Union Jack in its corner. The UK flag is the Union Jack alone; Tuvalu's has a light blue field with nine yellow stars.
gh|gw: Ghana and Guinea-Bissau both use red, yellow, green and a black star. Ghana has three horizontal stripes with the star in the middle; Guinea-Bissau has a vertical red band at the hoist holding the star.
gh|lt: Ghana and Lithuania both have red, yellow and green stripes. Ghana has red on top and a black star; Lithuania has yellow on top and no emblem.
gh|mm: Ghana and Myanmar both have red, yellow and green stripes with a star. Ghana has red on top and a small black star; Myanmar has yellow on top and a large white star.
gh|st: Ghana and São Tomé and Príncipe both have black stars on a yellow stripe. Ghana has one star with red on top; São Tomé has two stars, green top and bottom, and a red triangle.
gn|ml: Guinea and Mali are both red, yellow and green vertical stripes in mirror order. Guinea starts with red at the hoist; Mali starts with green.
gn|sn: Guinea and Senegal both have red, yellow and green vertical stripes. Guinea starts with red and is plain; Senegal starts with green and has a green star in the center.
gr|uy: Greece and Uruguay both have nine blue and white stripes with a corner square. Greece's corner is blue with a white cross; Uruguay's is white with a golden sun, and its blue is lighter.
gt|hn: Guatemala and Honduras are both blue-white-blue. Guatemala's bands are vertical with a coat of arms; Honduras' are horizontal with five blue stars.
gt|ni: Guatemala and Nicaragua are both blue-white-blue with a central emblem. Guatemala's bands are vertical; Nicaragua's are horizontal, with a triangle emblem.
gt|sv: Guatemala and El Salvador are both blue-white-blue with a central emblem. Guatemala's bands are vertical; El Salvador's are horizontal, with a triangle emblem.
gw|mg: Guinea-Bissau and Madagascar both have a vertical band at the hoist and two horizontal bands. Guinea-Bissau's hoist band is red with a black star, then yellow over green; Madagascar's is white, then red over green.
gw|st: Guinea-Bissau and São Tomé and Príncipe both use red at the hoist with black stars, yellow and green. Guinea-Bissau has a red band with one star; São Tomé has a red triangle and two stars on a yellow stripe.
hn|ni: Honduras and Nicaragua are both horizontal blue-white-blue. Honduras has five blue stars in the center; Nicaragua has a triangle coat of arms.
hn|sv: Honduras and El Salvador are both horizontal blue-white-blue. Honduras has five blue stars in the center; El Salvador has a triangle coat of arms.
hr|lu: Croatia and Luxembourg are both red, white and blue. Croatia has a large checkerboard shield in the center; Luxembourg is plain with a lighter blue.
hr|nl: Croatia and the Netherlands are both red, white and blue horizontal stripes. Croatia has a red-and-white checkerboard shield in the center; the Netherlands is plain.
hr|py: Croatia and Paraguay are both red, white and blue with a central emblem. Croatia has a large checkerboard shield spilling over the stripes; Paraguay has a small round seal inside the white band.
hr|rs: Croatia and Serbia both use red, white and blue with a coat of arms. Croatia's order is red-white-blue with a checkerboard shield; Serbia's is red-blue-white with an eagle shield towards the hoist.
ht|li: Haiti and Liechtenstein are both blue over red. Haiti has a white panel with a coat of arms in the center; Liechtenstein has a small gold crown in the top corner.
hu|ir: Hungary and Iran both have red, white and green stripes in opposite order. Hungary has red on top and is plain; Iran has green on top with a red emblem and script.
hu|it: Hungary and Italy are both red, white and green. Hungary's stripes are horizontal, red on top; Italy's are vertical, green at the hoist.
hu|tj: Hungary and Tajikistan are both red, white and green from the top. Hungary's stripes are equal and plain; Tajikistan's white stripe is wider and has a gold crown and stars.
id|mc: Indonesia and Monaco are both red over white. Indonesia's flag is longer (2:3) while Monaco's is nearly square (4:5); Poland flips the colors, white over red.
id|pl: Indonesia and Poland both have two bands of red and white. Indonesia has red on top; Poland has white on top.
id|sg: Indonesia and Singapore are both red over white. Indonesia is plain; Singapore has a white crescent and five stars in the top-left corner.
ie|in: Ireland and India both use green, white and orange. Ireland's stripes are vertical with green at the hoist; India's are horizontal with saffron on top and a blue wheel in the center.
ie|it: Ireland and Italy both have vertical stripes starting green, then white. The last stripe differs: orange for Ireland, red for Italy.
ie|mx: Ireland and Mexico both have vertical stripes starting green, then white. Ireland ends with orange and is plain; Mexico ends with red and has an eagle in the center.
in|ne: India and Niger are both orange, white and green with a disc in the center. India's disc is a blue wheel; Niger's is a plain orange disc, and its flag is nearly square.
iq|sy: Iraq and Syria both have white and black stripes with a central emblem. Iraq's top stripe is red with green script; Syria's is green, with three red stars.
iq|ye: Iraq and Yemen are both red, white and black horizontal stripes. Iraq has green Arabic script ("Allahu akbar") across the white stripe; Yemen's flag is completely plain.
ir|tj: Iran and Tajikistan both have green, white and red stripes. Iran has green on top and a red emblem; Tajikistan has red on top, a much wider white stripe and a gold crown under seven stars.
is|no: Iceland and Norway share the same off-center Nordic cross with a white border. Iceland is a blue flag with a red cross; Norway is a red flag with a blue cross.
it|mx: Italy and Mexico are both green, white and red vertical stripes. Mexico has an eagle-and-cactus coat of arms in the center and a longer shape; Italy's flag is plain.
jo|kw: Jordan and Kuwait both use black, white, green and red. Jordan has black on top with a red triangle holding a white star; Kuwait has green on top with a black trapezoid at the hoist.
jo|ps: Jordan and Palestine are identical black, white and green stripes with a red triangle at the hoist. Only Jordan has a small white seven-pointed star in the triangle.
jo|sd: Jordan and Sudan both have three stripes with a triangle at the hoist. Jordan is black on top with a red triangle and white star; Sudan is red on top with a plain green triangle.
jp|pw: Japan and Palau both show a single disc. Japan's is a red disc centered on white; Palau's is a yellow disc on light blue, set slightly towards the hoist.
ke|mw: Kenya and Malawi both have black, red and green horizontal stripes. Kenya has thin white stripes and a shield with spears in the center; Malawi has a red rising sun on the top black stripe.
ke|ss: Kenya and South Sudan share black, red and green stripes separated by thin white lines. Kenya has a shield and spears in the center; South Sudan has a blue triangle with a yellow star at the hoist.
kg|mk: Kyrgyzstan and North Macedonia both show a yellow sun on red. North Macedonia's eight broad rays stretch to the edges and corners; Kyrgyzstan's sun has many short rays and a red yurt-crown pattern inside.
kh|la: Cambodia and Laos both have three horizontal bands of red and blue. Cambodia is blue-red-blue with the white Angkor Wat temple; Laos is red-blue-red with a plain white disc.
kh|th: Cambodia and Thailand both use red, white and blue horizontal bands. Cambodia has blue at the top and bottom with a white temple in the center; Thailand has red at the top and bottom, with white stripes and no emblem.
kn|tt: Saint Kitts and Nevis and Trinidad and Tobago both have a black diagonal band. Trinidad's runs down from the upper hoist on plain red; Saint Kitts' rises from the lower hoist, edged in yellow, with two stars and green and red triangles.
kn|tz: Saint Kitts and Nevis and Tanzania both have a yellow-edged black diagonal band with green above it. Saint Kitts has red below and two white stars on the band; Tanzania has blue below and no stars.
kw|ps: Kuwait and Palestine both have three stripes with a shape at the hoist. Kuwait is green on top with a black trapezoid; Palestine is black on top with a red triangle.
kw|sd: Kuwait and Sudan both use green, white, red and black. Kuwait has green on top and a black trapezoid at the hoist; Sudan has red on top and a green triangle at the hoist.
la|th: Laos and Thailand both have red outer bands and a wide blue center band. Laos has a white disc on the blue; Thailand has no disc but thin white stripes on each side of the blue.
lb|pe: Lebanon and Peru are both red and white with white in the middle. Lebanon's bands are horizontal with a green cedar tree; Peru's are vertical.
lr|my: Liberia and Malaysia both have red and white stripes with a blue canton. Liberia has a single white star; Malaysia has a yellow crescent and a yellow 14-pointed star.
lr|tg: Liberia and Togo both have horizontal stripes and a square canton with one white star. Liberia is red and white with a blue canton; Togo is green and yellow with a red canton.
lr|us: Liberia and the United States both have red and white stripes with a blue canton. Liberia's canton holds just one large white star; the US canton holds 50 small stars.
ls|sl: Lesotho and Sierra Leone both use blue, white and green horizontal stripes. Lesotho has blue on top and a black hat in a wider white stripe; Sierra Leone has green on top and no emblem.
lt|mm: Lithuania and Myanmar both have yellow, green and red horizontal stripes. Myanmar has a large white star across all three stripes; Lithuania's flag is plain.
lu|nl: Luxembourg and the Netherlands are both red, white and blue horizontal stripes. Luxembourg's bottom stripe is a lighter sky blue; the Netherlands' is a darker blue.
lu|py: Luxembourg and Paraguay are both red, white and blue horizontal stripes. Paraguay has a round emblem in the center and a darker blue; Luxembourg's is plain, with light sky blue.
ma|vn: Morocco and Vietnam both have a five-pointed star on a red field. Vietnam's star is solid yellow; Morocco's is a green outline of interlaced lines.
mc|pl: Monaco and Poland are both two bands of red and white. Monaco has red on top; Poland has white on top.
mc|sg: Monaco and Singapore are both red over white. Singapore has a white crescent and five stars in the upper hoist; Monaco's is plain and nearly square (4:5).
md|ro: Moldova and Romania are both blue, yellow and red vertical stripes. Moldova has an eagle coat of arms in the center; Romania's flag is plain.
md|td: Moldova and Chad are both blue, yellow and red vertical stripes. Moldova has an eagle coat of arms in the center; Chad's flag is plain, with a darker blue.
ml|sn: Mali and Senegal are both green, yellow and red vertical stripes. Senegal has a green star in the center; Mali's flag is plain.
mr|pk: Mauritania and Pakistan are both green with a crescent and star. Pakistan has a white band at the hoist and a white crescent; Mauritania has a yellow crescent and star with red stripes at the top and bottom.
mw|ss: Malawi and South Sudan both have black, red and green horizontal stripes. Malawi has a red rising sun on the black stripe; South Sudan has thin white stripes and a blue triangle with a yellow star.
my|us: Malaysia and the United States both have red and white stripes with a blue canton. Malaysia's canton has a yellow crescent and star; the US canton has 50 white stars.
na|sb: Namibia and Solomon Islands both split diagonally into blue above and green below. Namibia has a wide red band and a gold sun; Solomon Islands has a thin yellow stripe and five white stars.
na|tz: Namibia and Tanzania both have a diagonal band from lower hoist to upper fly. Namibia's band is red with white edges, with blue above holding a sun; Tanzania's is black with yellow edges, with green above.
ni|sv: Nicaragua and El Salvador are both blue-white-blue with a triangular emblem. El Salvador's blue is darker and its emblem has flags and a green laurel wreath; Nicaragua's is a plain triangle in a ring of text.
nl|py: The Netherlands and Paraguay are both red, white and blue horizontal stripes. Paraguay has a round emblem in the center of the white stripe; the Dutch flag is plain.
nz|tv: New Zealand and Tuvalu both have the Union Jack in the corner and stars on blue. New Zealand has four red stars on dark blue; Tuvalu has nine yellow stars on light blue.
pk|tr: Pakistan and Turkey both show a white crescent and star. Turkey's field is red; Pakistan's is dark green with a white band at the hoist.
pl|sg: Poland and Singapore are both red and white halves. Poland has white on top and no emblem; Singapore has red on top with a white crescent and five stars.
ps|sd: Palestine and Sudan both have three stripes and a triangle at the hoist. Palestine is black on top with a red triangle; Sudan is red on top with a green triangle.
ro|td: Romania and Chad are almost identical blue, yellow and red vertical stripes. The only difference is the shade: Chad's blue is darker (indigo), Romania's is brighter.
rs|ru: Serbia and Russia both use red, blue and white horizontal stripes. Serbia has red on top and a coat of arms; Russia has white on top and no emblem.
rs|si: Serbia and Slovenia both use red, blue and white stripes with a coat of arms. Serbia has red on top and a red shield with a white eagle; Slovenia has white on top and a blue shield with a mountain.
rs|sk: Serbia and Slovakia both use red, blue and white stripes with a coat of arms. Serbia has red on top and a white eagle; Slovakia has white on top and a white double cross on a red shield.
ru|si: Russia and Slovenia are both white, blue and red horizontal stripes. Slovenia has a small blue shield with a white mountain in the upper hoist; Russia's flag is plain.
ru|sk: Russia and Slovakia are both white, blue and red horizontal stripes. Slovakia has a red shield with a white double cross on the hoist side; Russia's flag is plain.
sb|tz: Solomon Islands and Tanzania both have a diagonal from lower hoist to upper fly with blue and green. Solomon Islands has blue above, a thin yellow stripe and white stars; Tanzania has green above and a wide black band.
sd|ss: Sudan and South Sudan both have three stripes and a triangle at the hoist. Sudan is red, white and black with a green triangle; South Sudan is black, red and green with a blue triangle and yellow star.
si|sk: Slovenia and Slovakia are both white, blue and red stripes with a coat of arms. Slovenia's is a small blue shield with a mountain, high in the corner; Slovakia's is a larger red shield with a white double cross.
sl|uz: Sierra Leone and Uzbekistan both use green, white and blue horizontal stripes. Sierra Leone has green on top and no emblem; Uzbekistan has blue on top, thin red lines and a crescent with stars.
sy|ye: Syria and Yemen both have horizontal stripes with white in the middle and black at the bottom. Syria has green on top and three red stars; Yemen has red on top and no emblem.
tn|tr: Tunisia and Turkey both show a crescent and star on red. Tunisia has a red crescent and star inside a white disc in the center; Turkey's white crescent and star sit directly on the red.
tw|ws: Taiwan and Samoa are both red with a blue canton. Taiwan's canton has a white sun; Samoa's has five white stars of the Southern Cross.
vu|za: Vanuatu and South Africa both have a sideways Y around a black triangle at the hoist. South Africa's Y is green with blue below; Vanuatu's Y is yellow with green below and a tusk emblem.
